title: KestrelCare Claims Audit Definitions: Measuring the Error in a Claim Payment
content:
**Definition.** The error in a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts claim payment is measured against the decision that payment settled (the claim decision entry the payment names) as follows:

- where the payment settled an approved decision and exceeds the amount that decision approved, the error is the part of the payment above the approved amount;
- where the payment settled an approved decision and does not exceed it but exceeds the coverage remaining the plan held before the payment, the error is the part of the payment above that coverage remaining;
- in every other case the error is the whole payment.

The coverage remaining the plan held before the payment is the coverage remaining the plan shows now plus that payment.

| Decision the payment settled | Payment compared with it | Error |
|---|---|---|
| approved | above the approved amount | payment less approved amount |
| approved | not above the approved amount, but above the coverage remaining held before the payment | payment less that coverage remaining |
| approved | within both | the whole payment |
| not approved | any | the whole payment |

## Examples (hypothetical payments)

- A payment of 2600.00 settled an approved decision of 2400.00: the error is 200.00.
- A payment of 2400.00 settled an approved decision of 2400.00 at a time the plan held 2090.00 of coverage remaining: the error is 310.00.
- A payment of 950.00 settled a decision that was a denial: the error is 950.00.
